ctx.x: That's right. Joe Smith's brother. And he rode with me. He was traveling with ...(?)... (?)..., and I stayed in (?) for about a month, and then I had to come back west. And he lived up on Sugar Hill, and he said he'd only seen his wife three days out of the year. Only with her three days out of the year. See, I didn't want that.
